provenance.source_note: Invented weekly analytics fixtures for an independent demonstration. No client data, live account connection, official API execution or live n8n execution is represented.
provenance.construction: Two complete adjacent Monday-Sunday weeks. Each CSV row is an invented weekly aggregate for one campaign or channel.

measurement_notes.meta: Purchases and revenue are synthetic Meta-attributed values. They are not reconciled to a real attribution window or account.
measurement_notes.ga4: Purchases and revenue are synthetic GA4 channel-attributed values. GA4 and Meta use separate invented measurement totals; do not add them together or interpret their difference as tracking loss.
measurement_notes.financial: Revenue is a reporting input, not verified receipts or net profit. ROAS equals attributed revenue divided by ad spend; it excludes all non-ad costs.
measurement_notes.comparison: Descriptive week-over-week arithmetic only; no causal claim or statistical significance inference. Percentage-point changes apply to rates. Percentage change from a zero baseline is undefined.
